items.title: Yusef Lateef — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: In fact, they told me about the esoteric astrology, and I went out on 42nd street and I bought the book they recommended.

ctx.x: And you set the pedals, and then you can just pull them, and you can hear the sheets of sound. Um...you can practice all the violin books, et cetera. Uh she was a heavy scholar of um...astrology. In fact, they told me about the esoteric astrology, and I went out on 42nd street and I bought the book they recommended. And there were things in there about hidden planets, which implies that there are things behind what you see.
